“ENTRo DATE
SECT J3,2023

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17, of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance be amended by changing all the B3-1 Community Shopping Center District

symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 12-L in the area bounded by

West 47" Street; a line 183.71 feet east of and parallel to South
Lamon Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West 47"
Street; and South Lamon Avenue,

to those of a C2-1 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 4841-4857 West 47 Street
